name: poketoken
title: PokeToken
description: Each member's PokeTokenBar Pokémon follows them around the office, sent by a small desktop companion.
longDescription:
PokeTokenBar raises a Pokémon with the AI coding tokens you use. With this plugin, the Pokémon it is raising becomes one of your pets (the bundled Pets plugin must be on): it follows you, wanders and comes back with your other pets, and changes when it hatches or evolves.

Each member creates an app token in the side panel (Plugins > PokeToken) and pastes it, with the office's address, into the PokeToken companion running next to PokeTokenBar. The companion reads PokeTokenBar's save once a minute and reports the current Pokémon (species, form, shiny) when it changes; nothing else from the save leaves the computer.

Sprites come from PMD SpriteCollab (CC BY-NC 4.0). They are not stored on this server: each viewer's browser downloads them from raw.githubusercontent.com, which therefore sees that viewer's IP address. Unofficial fan plugin, not affiliated with Nintendo, Creatures, GAME FREAK or The Pokémon Company.
